name: Renta Corporacion Real Estate, S.A.
summary: Renta Corporación Real Estate, S.A. engages in the acquisition, refurbishment, and sale of real estate properties in the cities of Barcelona and Madrid. The company's property portfolio comprises residential buildings, offices, and parking spaces, as well as commercial premises and hotels. It serves individuals, companies, institutions, and real estate agents. Renta Corporación Real Estate, S.A. was founded in 1991 and is based in Barcelona, Spain.
